upload_id.meaning: Upload session identifier from the HTTP path; an unknown identifier succeeds without a removal.

x-caduceus-document.meaning: HTTP header matching the session document when the session exists.

x-caduceus-attendance.meaning: HTTP attendance header, required for an existing session started on attendance basis.

ok.meaning: True after removal, or when the session or spool is already absent; false on handler refusal.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists the fixed literal handler refusals. The handler supplies no open-form signals; its success body does not supply this field.
